criteria.justification: The response immediately makes a clear, definitive call in its opening line: "I would roll back (disable/feature-flag off) the new integration launch right now."

The candidate explicitly compares the reversibility of both paths, noting that "Rollback is reversible — we can re-launch once fixed," whereas "Leaving it live... is not obviously reversible in terms of customer trust and support load."

The response directly weighs these tradeoffs, contrasting the "active harm that compounds every hour" for existing customers against the "reputational/scheduling friction" and "undoing a commitment" associated with rolling back the announced launch.

The response completely avoids betting on a fast fix by opting for an immediate rollback, correctly noting that optimizing for a multi-day proper fix during an active incident is the wrong approach and that rollback is "not a gamble."

The candidate provides a detailed list of next steps, including drafting specific communications for both affected existing customers and new integration customers, as well as opening a "follow-up track" to build the proper fix and a re-launch plan.
